name: Reproducibility Verification
description: Verify that builds are reproducible: same inputs produce bitwise-identical outputs.
purpose: Establish build reproducibility so any independent party can verify that the published artifact was produced from the claimed source code, detecting tampering or build environment compromise.
acceptanceCriteria: Build process is containerized and fully deterministic (no timestamps, randomized seeds, or network-dependent sources).
Two independent builds from the same commit produce bitwise-identical outputs.
CI pipeline includes a reproducibility check: build twice, diff outputs.
Non-reproducible builds fail CI with a clear diff report.
Sources of non-reproducibility are documented and tracked.
Reproducibility is verified across different architectures if multi-arch releases are produced.
Reproducibility attestation is published alongside the release artifact.
